baseline_models.focus_anchor: The deictic frame هَٰذَا يَوْمُ and the negated plural verb لَا يَنطِقُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The severe-event branch of Y-W-M makes the day a befalling occasion, while the articulated-speech branch of N-T-Q supplies the channel absent from its participants. The verse therefore predicates an occasion-wide speech suspension rather than a permanent trait.

activation_trace.role: The event-day or severe-occasion image turns يَوْمُ into the defining event-frame for the silence.
The articulated-speech image supplies the human output channel that لَا shuts down collectively.

changed_reading.before: They do not talk on this day.
changed_reading.after: This severe event-occasion is characterized by their collective failure or inability to produce articulated speech.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The N-T-Q root in يَنطِقُونَ under the negation لَا.
baseline_models.mechanism: N-T-Q also names a sign, book, lesson, or sound that discloses meaning as though it spoke. Activating that branch expands the negation from lack of audible words to lack of intelligible self-manifestation or evidentiary indication.

activation_trace.role: The speech-like-indication image broadens the blocked output from sound to anything that would disclose a usable meaning from them.

changed_reading.before: No audible speech comes from them.
changed_reading.after: No intelligible self-disclosure, sign, or evidentiary meaning issues from them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later repetition هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ names the same deictically presented occasion as a separating judgment. Silence is consequently not just an atmosphere of disaster; it is a procedural condition under which decisive differentiation proceeds.

activation_trace.role: The focus event-day image supplies the severe occasion whose function the later repetition specifies.
The articulated-speech image supplies the participant channel suspended inside the named occasion.
The repeated event-day image identifies the later named occasion with the focus frame.
The judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the occasion's adjudicative function and makes silence procedurally consequential.

structural_cues: 77:38 repeats the exact deictic nominal frame هَٰذَا يَوْمُ and adds ٱلْفَصْلِ as its name.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated frame and a branch of decisive judgment; I infer that the speech suspension serves that adjudicative process. A live alternative is that فَصْل marks broad cosmic separation without imposing a courtroom model.

changed_reading.before: A severe day happens to contain collective silence.
changed_reading.after: The day is the adjudicative event of separation, and their speech is suspended within its decisive procedure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation denies permission and links that denial to making an excuse. It narrows the most salient blocked speech to authorized exculpatory pleading: the subjects are not merely mute, but receive no turn in which an excuse can become an admissible defense.

activation_trace.role: The articulated-speech image supplies the general output channel that the continuation narrows to a defense plea.
The excuse-and-apology image identifies the exact exculpatory speech genre whose production is blocked.
The permission-and-licensing image supplies the procedural gate that is withheld before an excuse can be voiced.

structural_cues: 77:36 immediately continues with وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ; the فَ links withheld permission to the unrealized excuse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a denied license followed by the excuse verb; I infer an admissibility or turn-taking rule for defense speech. A live alternative is that 77:36 adds a second disability rather than specifying the full scope of لَا يَنطِقُونَ.

changed_reading.before: They cannot produce speech in general.
changed_reading.after: They are denied an authorized speaking turn, so no exculpatory plea can enter the judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated designation of the subjects as those who attribute falsehood brackets the silence unit immediately before and after it. That framing turns generic non-speech into a reversal of their defining counter-speech: the discourse that called the warning false no longer operates.

activation_trace.role: The articulated-speech image supplies the channel whose prior polemical use is now reversed.
The image of attributing something or its bearer to falsehood identifies the speech practice attached to them immediately before the focus.
The same falsehood-attribution image closes the unit and keeps that prior counterclaim as the salient discourse now unavailable.

structural_cues: The identical refrain at 77:34 and 77:37 encloses 77:35-36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tight refrain bracket and the falsehood-attribution branch; I infer reciprocal reversal from past denial to present inability to answer. A live alternative is that the refrain identifies the people without specifying which speech content is silenced.

changed_reading.before: The condemned group happens to be silent.
changed_reading.after: Those defined by speech that branded the warning false can no longer issue that counterclaim when the warned event is present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first presents prominent celestial indicators and then erases their trace, while the focus root can treat an indication as speaking when it discloses meaning. By analogy, the subjects' non-speaking becomes a semiotic blackout: they no longer furnish a legible sign of their own case.

activation_trace.role: The speech-like-indication image supplies the semiotic channel whose disappearance is read alongside erased celestial signs.
The prominent-sign or conspicuous-knowledge image makes the stars function as legible indicators before their effacement.
The erasure-of-trace image supplies the operation transferred analogically to the subjects' capacity to signify.

structural_cues: 77:8 compresses indicator and erasure into the passive sequence ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ before 77:35 negates meaning-bearing output.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a conspicuous-sign branch, trace erasure, and N-T-Q's indicative branch; I supply the cross-domain analogy from cosmic effacement to human self-signification. A live alternative is that the stars remain only physical portents and do not govern the speech clause.

changed_reading.after: Like an effaced sign, they furnish no legible self-indication from which a defense or counter-meaning could be read.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plural subject of يَنطِقُونَ is later placed inside a gathering that joins the addressed group with all preceding cohorts. Silence thus scales from an unspecified plurality to an assembly-wide suspension across historical succession.

activation_trace.role: The articulated-speech image supplies the capacity negated for the plural assembly.
The beginning-and-precedence image extends the silent gathering backward to the earliest or preceding cohorts.
The image of joining dispersed elements into one whole supplies the social-spatial assembly over which silence holds.

structural_cues: 77:38 follows the silence with the direct plural address جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a plural speech negation and an all-cohort gathering; I infer that the silence is assembly-wide rather than a series of private failures. A live alternative is that gathering only identifies the audience and does not intensify the speech negation.

changed_reading.before: Some plural group does not speak.
changed_reading.after: The gathered historical assembly, including preceding cohorts, stands under one collective suspension of speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrasting reward scene explicitly links recompense to prior purposeful work. Read against that causal economy, the focus silence means that present claims cannot replace completed action: adjudication answers what was done rather than what can now be said.

activation_trace.role: The articulated-speech image supplies the present claim-making channel displaced by the record of purposeful action.
The purposeful-action image supplies the completed conduct on which outcome is said to rest.
The action-for-recompense image supplies the response rule that privileges prior conduct over a present verbal claim.

structural_cues: 77:43-44 pairs بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ with نَجْزِى, whereas 77:35-36 removes speech and excuse from the other group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit deed-to-recompense relation in the contrasting scene; I infer that present speech cannot substitute for those deeds. A live alternative is that the positive reward scene does not state a general evidentiary rule for 77:35.

changed_reading.before: The subjects are simply unable to talk.
changed_reading.after: At reckoning, completed conduct has displaced present claims, so speech cannot renegotiate the outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later clause pairs speech directed to them with their refusal of embodied humility, using the same لَا plus plural imperfect contour as the focus. The focus silence becomes a reciprocal reversal: when addressed they withheld the fitting bodily response; on the day of separation their own verbal response is unavailable.

activation_trace.role: The articulated-speech image supplies their now-blocked side of the address-and-response relation.
The image of producing a spoken utterance supplies the command previously directed toward them.
The humility-and-abasement image supplies the embodied response they refused when speech reached them.

structural_cues: 77:35 لَا يَنطِقُونَ and 77:48 لَا يَرْكَعُونَ share a negated third-person plural imperfect, while 77:48 explicitly begins the exchange with قِيلَ لَهُمُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the close syntactic echo and an address followed by refused humility; I infer a reciprocal moral reversal between withheld response and unavailable response. A live alternative is that 77:48 describes a general disposition without a temporal or causal link to the judgment silence.

changed_reading.before: Their inability to speak is an isolated judgment-day condition.
changed_reading.after: Their unavailable verbal response mirrors their earlier refusal to answer addressed speech with embodied submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing question joins renewed discourse to heart-settled assent and asks what could operate after this message. Together with the focus negation, it frames a failed communication circuit: no valid utterance comes from the judged subjects, and no subsequent discourse remains capable of eliciting their trust.

activation_trace.role: The articulated-speech image supplies the failed output side of the communication circuit.
The renewed-report or discourse image supplies the possible incoming message whose efficacy the closing question denies.
The heart-settled-assent image supplies the reception state that no later discourse is expected to produce.

structural_cues: The surah closes at 77:50 with a rhetorical question that directly couples حَدِيثٍ with يُؤْمِنُونَ after the focus has negated their own speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent output in 77:35 and a final discourse-to-assent question in 77:50; I infer a two-sided communicative closure. A live alternative is that 77:50 addresses a present audience rather than the same subjects or scene as 77:35.

changed_reading.before: They cannot speak at one moment in the judgment scene.
changed_reading.after: Their silence participates in a wider communicative closure: they offer no valid speech, and no further discourse can move them to settled assent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the verbal form in 77:35 conventionally activates speech, while N-T-Q's clan-as-girdle image and F-S-L's clan branch are form- and sense-distant. It remains packet-anchored in the focus root and is activated by 77:38's separation and gathering images; downstream prose should present it only as an etymological or imagistic shadow, never as the verse's direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The N-T-Q root of يَنطِقُونَ, especially its image of kin strengthening a person like a girdle.

activation_trace.role: The kinship-support-as-girdle image supplies an exploratory shadow in which negated N-T-Q means having no clan-strength to gird oneself with.
The image of a man's clan from his people activates the social unit that might otherwise furnish girdle-like support on the day of separation.
The gathering-of-the-dispersed image places all potential supporters together yet unable to become an effective supporting belt.

changed_reading.after: As a contained root-play, they also stand ungirded by kinship support: gathering does not become a coalition capable of helping them.

strongest_changes: 77:38 directly names the focus event as the day of separating judgment, making silence procedural rather than merely atmospheric.
77:36 narrows the blocked speech to an unlicensed exculpatory plea.
The bracketing falsehood refrain turns silence into reversal of the subjects' former denying counter-speech.
77:48 mirrors لَا يَنطِقُونَ with لَا يَرْكَعُونَ, linking unavailable verbal response to previously withheld embodied response.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposed exact local specification at 77:36 and 77:38, while distant repetitions opened two additional mechanisms: a deed-over-claim economy and a speech/embodied-response reversal. It also made the N-T-Q indication and girdle branches testable without collapsing them into the literal speech reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 77:35 denotes total incapacity to speak or chiefly the denial of an authorized defense turn.
Whether the refrain bracket specifies denial as the silenced content or only labels the silent group.
The semiotic-blackout and kinship-girdle readings are branch-backed but depend on reader-supplied cross-domain analogy and must remain exploratory.
